{{Quote|Zygerrians, you say? No stranger to them am I. Thrived on Outer Rim slave trade for centuries did the Zygerrian civilization. Moved from system to system, abducting primitive beings for profit&mdash;even into the systems of the Republic. When ordered to cease, resist did the Zygerrians. Crushed their empire of bondage did the Jedi.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="TCW2">[[The Clone Wars 2|''The Clone Wars'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Zygerrian Slave Empire''', known as the '''Zygerrian Empire''', was a government of the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrians]] that prospered as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]-trading enterprise in the centuries leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|Ruined were these slavers, but refuse they did to change their ways.|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]|<ref name="TCW2" />}}
[[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] sold slave labor throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for thousands of years before the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] destroyed the Empire in a [[Jedi–Zygerrian conflict/Legends|conflict]]. The Zygerrian slaver [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] felt great resentment towards the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] for this act and longed to take revenge for his people.

Nevertheless, despite their empire being shattered, the Zygerrian trade continued in the form of the [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Zygerrians plotted with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to bring back the [[Royal Slave Auction/Legends|Royal Slave Auction]], a tradition of the old Empire. To this end, they kidnapped [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists from the planet [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]].

==Military==
Although the Zygerrian Slave Empire had no organized military, they used [[shock whip]]s, [[YV-865 Aurore-class freighter/Legends|YV-865 ''Aurore''-class freighters]], [[Thermal annihilator bomb/Legends|thermal annihilator bombs]], [[Zygerrian blaster rifle/Legends|Zygerrian blaster rifles]], [[Freighter-class vessel|Zygerrian ''Freighter''-class vessels]], [[Shock collar/Legends|slaving collars]], and a [[Zygerrian space station]]. They were also provided with [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]], [[AAT Driver Battle Droid/Legends|AAT driver battle droids]], [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], [[Sniper droideka/Legends|sniper droidekas]], [[Flitknot speeder/Legends|Flitknot speeders]], and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
